title: UP Anganwadi Worker Bharti Online Form 2026
organization: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
vacancyDetails: District-wise Anganwadi Worker posts under UP ICDS / WCD recruitment 2026
qualification: 12th Pass (Intermediate) from recognized board; local residence criteria as per district notice
ageLimit: As per UP Anganwadi Worker district recruitment rules
applicationFee: As per district portal (often nil or nominal)
selectionProcess: Merit based on educational marks / local criteria → Document Verification → Appointment
documentsRequired: 12th marksheet, residence proof, photo ID, passport photos, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit official UP WCD / district Anganwadi recruitment portal
2. Select district and post – Anganwadi Worker
3. Register and fill online form
4. Upload documents and submit
5. Track merit list on district portal
shortDescription: UP Anganwadi Worker Bharti Online Form 2026. District-wise apply for AWW posts (12th pass).
content:
Uttar Pradesh Women and Child Development / ICDS has opened district-wise online applications for Anganwadi Worker (AWW) Bharti 2026.

Eligibility is generally 12th pass with residence in the concerned project / centre area. Exact vacancies and last dates are published district-wise on official portals.
